world.title: US-Iran War Live: US to begin enforcing maritime blockade on Iran from Tuesday amid Gulf tensions
world.summary: The US plans to enforce a maritime blockade on Iran starting Tuesday amid escalating tensions, with both nations exchanging missile and drone strikes. Iran claims to have closed the Strait of Hormuz, while the US insists it remains open. The conflict has affected Gulf nations, disrupted energy corridors, and raised oil prices, complicating diplomatic efforts for peace.

world.title: Ex-Iran President under house arrest over Israel plot to regime change
world.summary: Former Iranian President Mahmoud Ahmadinejad is reportedly under house arrest following allegations of secret contacts with Israeli intelligence aimed at regime change in Iran. The New York Times detailed unverified claims of meetings in Hungary and a failed extraction plan. Ahmadinejad, known for his strong anti-Israel rhetoric during his presidency, has not officially responded to these allegations.

world.title: Middle East crisis: US to resume naval blockade of Iranian ports, warns vessels of interception
world.summary: The United States will reinstate a maritime blockade on Iran starting Tuesday, aimed at all vessels entering or leaving Iranian ports and coastal regions. This decision comes amid rising tensions between Washington and Tehran. The US has warned that vessels violating the blockade may face interception, reflecting ongoing concerns regarding Iran's activities in the region.

business.title: Satya Nadella has issued a shocking warning to companies using AI
business.summary: Satya Nadella has raised concerns about the risks associated with companies using proprietary AI models. He warns that major AI labs may be functioning like Trojan horses, potentially introducing unforeseen challenges. This issue has sparked significant anxiety among AI enthusiasts in Silicon Valley, highlighting the ongoing debates regarding the implications and downsides of artificial intelligence in various sectors.

business.title: Gold price crashes as Waller warning sparks Fed hike fears
business.summary: Gold prices (XAU/USD) fell sharply on Monday, dropping nearly 3% following comments from Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller. Waller indicated that if the Consumer Price Index (CPI) increases this week, the Fed may need to consider raising interest rates. This statement heightened concerns about potential monetary policy changes, leading to a significant decline in gold prices.

business.title: Trade Setup for July 14: Top 15 things to know before the opening bell
business.summary: The Nifty 50 must break the 23,800-24,300 range to determine its direction. Sustaining above 24,300 may lead to an uptrend towards 24,400-24,500, while a drop below 23,800 could result in consolidation. On July 13, the index rebounded after finding support at 24,000, closing flat with a positive bias, following several positive closes in previous sessions.

technology.title: Apple iPhone gets iOS 27 public beta with Siri AI and up to 80% performance improvements
technology.summary: Apple has released the public beta of iOS 27 for iPhone users, featuring new enhancements like Siri AI and performance improvements of up to 80%. Users can also customize Liquid Glass. The final version is anticipated to launch in September or October. Siri AI combines elements of ChatGPT and OpenClaw, marking a significant upgrade for the iPhone experience.

technology.title: Apple iPhone Ultra and 2026 Foldable Launch Set for September 8
technology.summary: Apple is set to unveil the iPhone Ultra on September 8, with indications that a foldable model may launch in 2026. Code discovered in iOS 27 hints at a feature for adjusting folding angles, suggesting Apple is strategically preparing for this innovation. This announcement is anticipated to generate significant interest among technology enthusiasts and consumers alike.

technology.title: New CrashStealer malware poses as Apple crash reporting tool
technology.summary: A new macOS malware named CrashStealer disguises itself as Apple's crash-reporting tool. It targets users by stealing credentials, keychain data, and cryptocurrency wallets. Malware researchers began monitoring CrashStealer in May, noting its deceptive tactics. The malware's ability to impersonate legitimate software raises concerns about security and user data protection on macOS devices.

sports.title: Which team are you rooting for now at World Cup 2026?
sports.summary: Spain, Argentina, England, and France are the last four teams competing in the semi-finals of World Cup 2026. These matches will take place this week, determining which two teams will advance to the final. SB Nation is conducting a poll to gauge fan support for the remaining teams, inviting readers to share their current favorites.

sports.title: FIDE Transforms 2027 World Cup Format
sports.summary: FIDE has announced a significant change to the format of the 2027 World Cup and Women's World Cup. The tournaments will no longer feature large knockout stages with 206 and 107 players, respectively. Instead, the final stage will consist of only 16 qualifiers competing in a knockout format, streamlining the competition for both events.

sports.title: Fleming exit may lead to wider CSK shake-up
sports.summary: Chennai Super Kings' long-serving head coach Stephen Fleming has departed, described by management as a mutual parting of ways. His exit may signal further changes within the team's coaching setup. CSK's management is reportedly considering additional adjustments, indicating that Fleming's removal could be the beginning of a broader restructuring within the franchise as they prepare for future seasons.

health.title: Asia-Pacific Roundup: India cuts prices of more than 30 drugs and biologics
health.summary: India's National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA) has reduced prices for over 30 drugs and biological products following a revision of the country's drug pricing legislation. This move aims to enhance affordability and accessibility of essential medications for the public. The government emphasizes its commitment to regulating drug prices to ensure that healthcare remains accessible to all citizens.

health.title: Gujarat govt confirms two more Chandipura deaths, awaits 8 lab reports
health.summary: The Gujarat government has confirmed two additional suspected deaths from the Chandipura virus, bringing the total to five. Out of 19 samples tested, seven returned positive, while results for eight samples are still pending. In response, the state has intensified surveillance, including fogging and sandfly control measures, to manage the outbreak and identify potential cases effectively.

health.title: Two suspected Chandipura deaths in Panchmahal, govt steps up surveillance
health.summary: Two suspected deaths from the Chandipura virus have been reported in Panchmahal district within 24 hours, leading the state government to enhance surveillance and expedite laboratory testing. Health officials are tracking 13 additional suspected cases in the area. The situation has raised concerns, prompting a swift response to monitor and manage the potential outbreak effectively.

science.title: ‘Sunlight on demand’: U.S. approves test of giant space mirror to redirect sunlight
science.summary: The U.S. has approved an experimental satellite project featuring a large mirror aimed at testing the concept of “sunlight on demand.” This satellite will reflect sunlight onto specific areas on Earth. The Federal Communications Commission issued a license for the project, which seeks to explore the feasibility of directing sunlight for various applications, including energy generation and agricultural enhancement.

science.title: Pluto has six confirmed landslides now, and their unusually long runouts are giving scientists a clue about how icy worlds move
science.summary: Scientists have confirmed six landslides on Pluto, identified through images from NASA's New Horizons spacecraft, which flew by the dwarf planet nearly 11 years ago. The enhanced color global view was created using data from the Long Range Reconnaissance Imager and the Ralph instrument. The unusually long runouts of these landslides provide insights into the movement of icy worlds.

science.title: Atlantic expedition captures rare footage of a ghostly barreleye fish with a see-through head
science.summary: Scientists have captured rare footage of a barreleye fish, known for its transparent dome-like head, alive in the wild for the first time. This sighting occurred in the Atlantic Ocean, highlighting the ongoing discovery of unique marine life even in well-studied environments. The footage serves as a reminder of the ocean's mysteries and the creatures that inhabit it.

entertainment.title: Anupam Kher on Naseeruddin Shah's resurfaced 'clown' remark: We respect each other
entertainment.summary: Actor Anupam Kher addressed Naseeruddin Shah's resurfaced "clown" remark, emphasizing their mutual respect despite past differences. Kher noted that they have met and embraced each other, reinforcing their camaraderie. He suggested that the revival of the six-year-old video aimed to target him following his recent comments about the Ram Temple, implying it was a deliberate attempt to provoke.

entertainment.title: Your Horoscope for the New Moon in Cancer
entertainment.summary: The New Moon in Cancer encourages self-acceptance and personal growth. It signifies a period for rejuvenation and manifestation, urging individuals to address areas of lack in their lives. This phase invites new experiences, relationships, or possessions, emphasizing the importance of making space for fresh beginnings. Embracing imperfections is essential during this time of transformation and renewal.

entertainment.title: Lock Upp 2: After announcing divorce from Gaurav Khanna, Akanksha Chamola opens up about becoming 'Asexual'
entertainment.summary: Akanksha Chamola announced her separation from husband Gaurav Khanna during the premiere of Lock Upp season 2. Following this revelation, she disclosed her identification as asexual in a recent episode of Lock Upp Sach Ya Sazaa. The discussions surrounding her personal life and sexual orientation have become a focal point in the ongoing reality show.
